description:
The image depicts a white Apple Magic Mouse, with a small pile of dark brown animal feces situated to its right. The mouse features a subtle Apple logo on its surface.

The background of the image is a gray concrete floor, which provides a neutral and industrial setting for the objects in question. Scattered around the mouse are several small pieces of red plant material, which adds a touch of natural beauty to the otherwise sterile environment.

In the bottom-right corner of the image, a small shadow is cast
